# Generated data catalogue

<!-- Generated by python -m market_data_hub.catalog_docs --write; do not edit. -->

Structured external data is collected here; news and web text belong to LazyCrawler, and applications never collect. This inventory is generated from the collector configs, macro release catalogue and the actual DuckDB/SQLite schemas (including migrations and optional worklist audit tables).

Regenerate with `python -m market_data_hub.catalog_docs --write`; CI runs `--check` against this page and [the machine-readable catalogue](data-catalog.json). Adding a source requires its collector configuration and regeneration.

**Expected lag** is declared calendar days from reference-period end to availability in the hub, initialized from the 31 October 2026 inventory. It is an estimate, not live-measured, and differs from a stalled-after age threshold. For weekly claims use survey week end; for candles use candle close; for event data use the event day. Zero permits same-day or before-period-end flash/survey releases. Payrolls use 7 days (usual range 2–7); OECD long rates use 60 (usual range 30–90). Monthly/quarterly dates can label period starts: do not subtract them directly to measure lag.

Schedules below name investmentcommittee jobs in America/Los_Angeles (PT, including DST). Fallback declarations were reviewed on 2026-10-31; per-entry job/schedule config overrides them. Schedules describe intended runs, not successful collection. `not configured` means the source declares no fixed floor or metadata, not that history is absent. Dynamic SEC/earnings company and CFTC contract universes are documented at table level. Multiple configured crypto timeframes and factor components have separate rows.

Prices use the collector's FRED-over-Yahoo precedence. Panel rows cover each indicator across configured countries; provider fallback metadata is in JSON. The macro store currently includes composition placeholders, explicitly disabled below.

Optional live inventory: `python -m market_data_hub.catalog_docs --live PATH_TO_DUCKDB PATH_TO_SQLITE` prints JSON read-only. Use `--write --output-dir DIR` to save an isolated live copy. Observations do not alter the declared metadata. No live database or credentials are used by generation or CI.

Topic guides: [Macro indicators](macro-indicators.md), [Macro releases](macro-releases.md), [Sovereign yields](f08-sovereign-yields.md), [Sovereign layers](sovereign-layers.md), [CFTC history](cftc-history.md), [ALFRED](alfred-backfill.md), [FRED FX](fred-fx.md), [Free sources / ACM](free-sources.md).

<a id="catalog-hub-alfred_backfill_pending"></a>

## hub / alfred_backfill_pending

Incomplete ALFRED range and pending vintage-page state, kept separately from completed progress.

- Store: `hub`; table: `alfred_backfill_pending`.
- Primary key: `series_id`, `since_vintage`.
- Status: active.
- Point-in-time / vintages: For observations, filter as_of <= cutoff and choose the latest as_of per series/date (respect vendor realtime_end when present). Progress/pending tables are mutable checkpoints, not vintages. Vendor knowledge is distinct from hub first-seen knowledge.
- Collection: hub pipeline / services; supporting state, no independent external collection schedule.
- Guide: [alfred-backfill.md](alfred-backfill.md).

<a id="catalog-hub-macro_series_vintage"></a>

## hub / macro_series_vintage

Hub-observed changes to macro_series, with ingestion-date vintages.

- Store: `hub`; table: `macro_series_vintage`.
- Primary key: `date`, `series_id`, `vintage_date`.
- Status: active.
- Point-in-time / vintages: macro_series is latest state. macro_series_vintage keeps hub ingestion-date changes: filter vintage_date <= cutoff then latest per series/date. Backfilled ingestion vintages are not issuer publication history; use ALFRED for vendor point-in-time data.
- Collection: hub pipeline / services; supporting state, no independent external collection schedule.
- Guide: [free-sources.md](free-sources.md).

<a id="catalog-hub-prices_daily"></a>

## hub / prices_daily

Daily OHLCV and adjusted closes by listing; is_live marks provisional intraday prices.

- Store: `hub`; table: `prices_daily`.
- Primary key: `date`, `listing_id`.
- Status: active.
- Point-in-time / vintages: Current state/upserted data; no historical as-known-at reconstruction from this table alone.
- Collection: daily_eu18 daily 09:00 PT; daily_usclose daily 13:15 PT.
- Guide: [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md).

<a id="catalog-hub-schema_meta"></a>

## hub / schema_meta

Warehouse schema version and migration metadata.

- Store: `hub`; table: `schema_meta`.
- Primary key: `key`.
- Status: active.
- Point-in-time / vintages: Current state/upserted data; no historical as-known-at reconstruction from this table alone.
- Collection: hub pipeline / services; supporting state, no independent external collection schedule.
- Guide: [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md).

<a id="catalog-hub-sec_company_facts"></a>

## hub / sec_company_facts

SEC XBRL facts with taxonomy, concept, unit, period and filing accession; revised filings remain distinct facts.

- Store: `hub`; table: `sec_company_facts`.
- Primary key: `fact_id`.
- Status: active.
- Point-in-time / vintages: Facts retain filing accession and filed date; select filings available by the cutoff before period/concept selection. This is filing availability, not proof of historical hub ingestion; coverage is current state.
- Collection: sec_facts on demand via financials service; no configured periodic schedule.
- Guide: [EXTRACTION.md](EXTRACTION.md).

<a id="catalog-hub-sec_coverage"></a>

## hub / sec_coverage

Recomputed SEC filing and fact coverage by CIK.

- Store: `hub`; table: `sec_coverage`.
- Primary key: `cik`.
- Status: active.
- Point-in-time / vintages: Facts retain filing accession and filed date; select filings available by the cutoff before period/concept selection. This is filing availability, not proof of historical hub ingestion; coverage is current state.
- Collection: sec_facts on demand via financials service; no configured periodic schedule.
- Guide: [EXTRACTION.md](EXTRACTION.md).

<a id="catalog-hub-sec_filings"></a>

## hub / sec_filings

SEC submission metadata by CIK and accession: filing form, filing date and report period; no per-company listing in this catalogue.

- Store: `hub`; table: `sec_filings`.
- Primary key: `cik`, `accession`.
- Status: active.
- Point-in-time / vintages: Facts retain filing accession and filed date; select filings available by the cutoff before period/concept selection. This is filing availability, not proof of historical hub ingestion; coverage is current state.
- Collection: sec_facts on demand via financials service; no configured periodic schedule.
- Guide: [EXTRACTION.md](EXTRACTION.md).

<a id="catalog-macro_releases-sqlite-worklist_resolutions"></a>

## macro_releases.sqlite / worklist_resolutions

Optional append-only worklist resolver decisions and prior-state evidence.

- Store: `macro_releases.sqlite`; table: `worklist_resolutions`.
- Primary key: `audit_id`.
- Status: active.
- Point-in-time / vintages: Use the macro ReadAPI with news_cutoff/as_known_at and first-seen/recorded-at filters before selection. Published time alone does not prove the hub knew a value. Raw readings and mirror evidence are not automatically official. Append-only vintages, schedules, consensus and resolution history preserve evidence; registry/worklist tables describe current state.
- Collection: macro_releases_daily daily 06:30 PT.
- Guide: [macro-releases.md](macro-releases.md).
